verdict.rationale: Permission control is a fair question for a work-tracking tool, but nothing in the pack documents roles, permission schemes, or view/edit access controls. 'SAML & SSO' covers authentication, not authorization. 'Global and project-level configuration' is a related setting and does not show granular permissions, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can assign granular permissions and roles to control who can view or edit work
